title: Valid Word
description: A word is considered valid if it contains a minimum of 3 characters, contains only digits (0-9) and English letters (uppercase and lowercase), includes at least one vowel, and includes at least one consonant. You are given a string word. Return true if word is valid, otherwise, return false.

examples.explanation: The length of this word is fewer than 3, and it does not have a vowel.
This word contains a '$' character and does not have a consonant.

constraints: word consists of English uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, '@', '#', and '$'.
